data.name: Bob
data.message: Calibration done, heading to weapons via cafeteria. Come with?

I found Alice's body in weapons just now. My route was lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons. 

In medbay around tick 6-8 I saw Eve doing stuff there, and Charlie left medbay heading to cafeteria at tick 6. Diana came into medbay from upper_engine at tick 7, then I later saw her in electrical at ticks 11-12.

So Eve, Diana, and Charlie are somewhat accounted for in my sightings. I never saw Frank the entire round — and someone had to get to weapons to kill Alice. Weapons is accessed from cafeteria or security. I'd really like to hear Frank's route. Suspicious of Frank right now.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine. 

I was in electrical ticks 2-4 with Charlie — he was there the whole time I was. Then I went to medbay where I saw Bob arrive from storage at tick 5, and I was with him through tick 7. Charlie left medbay to cafeteria at tick 6, and Diana came in from upper_engine at tick 7. Bob left to electrical at tick 8. After that I went cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine and didn't see anyone else.

So my sightings line up with Bob's story — he was in medbay when he said he was, and Diana did come from upper_engine. I also never saw Frank the entire round. Frank needs to account for himself — weapons is reachable from cafeteria or security, and nobody seems to have eyes on him. Leaning Frank too, but let's hear him out.

My route was security -> navigation -> storage -> medbay. I started in security around ticks 1-3 working on the task there, then moved to navigation around ticks 4-6, then down to storage, and finally up to medbay where the meeting was called.

I know I look suspicious because nobody saw me, but think about it — security connects directly to weapons. If I had killed Alice in weapons, why would I go the long way around through navigation and storage? I'd have just hit weapons from security and that's it. Instead I went the opposite direction.

Here's what bothers me about Bob's story: Bob says his route ended at weapons where he found Alice. Cafeteria -> weapons is 2 ticks. Bob conveniently "discovers" the body right after arriving. And Eve only vouches for Bob being in medbay early — not for where he went after electrical at tick 8 onward. Bob could have gone electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons and killed Alice himself, then reported.

I was nowhere near weapons. Charlie hasn't spoken yet — I want to hear his route and whether anyone can vouch for Bob's later movements. Don't tunnel on me just because I was doing solo tasks on the opposite side of the map.

My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security. I can confirm a lot of what's been said.

I came into medbay from upper_engine at tick 7 — that matches what Bob and Eve said. I saw both Bob and Eve in medbay at tick 7. At tick 8, Eve left medbay heading to cafeteria, and Bob left medbay heading to electrical. I then went to electrical myself and saw Bob there at tick 11. At tick 12, Bob left electrical heading to cafeteria. After that I continued to security, where the meeting was called.

So here's the important part for Frank's accusation: Bob did leave electrical to cafeteria at tick 12. From cafeteria to weapons is 2 ticks, so Bob could have reached weapons around tick 14. That's tight but possible. However, Eve also went cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine, so Eve was in cafeteria around tick 9-10 and wouldn't have seen Bob's later movement.

That said — Frank's route of security -> navigation -> storage -> medbay is also completely unverified, and security is the OTHER entrance to weapons. Frank starting in security is actually very convenient for a weapons kill.

I'm torn between Bob and Frank honestly. Both had opportunity. Eve, Charlie, and I have decent mutual alibis in medbay/electrical. I lean slightly Frank because his starting position in security gives the most direct access to weapons, but I want to hear Charlie before deciding.

My route was medbay -> electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation. I know — I was in weapons. Let me be upfront about it because lying would be stupid when timing can be reconstructed.

I was in electrical ticks 3-4 with Eve, that matches her story. Back to medbay around tick 6 where I saw Bob arriving and Eve still there. Then I went cafeteria, then weapons around tick 9. **Alice was alive in weapons when I was there at tick 9.** I didn't see anyone else there with her. I left through security and ended up in navigation when the meeting was called.

So whoever killed Alice came into weapons AFTER tick 9. That fits Bob's timeline really well — Diana just confirmed Bob left electrical at tick 12 toward cafeteria, and cafeteria -> weapons is 2 ticks, putting him in weapons around tick 14. He then "discovers" the body he just made.

Frank's route doesn't actually pass through weapons — he went security -> navigation -> storage -> medbay, AWAY from weapons. If he'd killed from security he wouldn't loop all the way around to medbay; he'd stay near the scene or have a cleaner alibi path.

Alice was alive at tick 9. Bob had means, opportunity, and reported the body. I'm voting Bob.

Wait — I already gave my speech first, and now everyone's piled on me at the end. Let me defend myself because Charlie's logic has a hole.

Charlie just admitted he was in weapons with Alice at tick 9. He says "Alice was alive when I left" — but that's literally what a killer would say. There's no witness to that. Charlie's own route is medbay -> electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation. He was ALONE with Alice in weapons. That's means and opportunity right there, with him admitting to being at the crime scene.

Yes, I went cafeteria -> weapons at the end. That's because weapons is on my task list — look at the map, weapons has a task marker for me. I went there to do my task and found Alice's body already there. If I were the killer, why would I report it? I could have just walked away and let someone else find it.

Charlie's framing is clever: "I was upfront about being in weapons so you'd trust me." But being upfront about being the last confirmed person with the victim doesn't make you innocent — it makes you the prime suspect. He had to mention it because Diana or someone might have seen him heading that way.

Also: Charlie says he went weapons -> security -> navigation. Did anyone see him in security or navigation? Frank said he was in security/navigation early — did your paths cross, Frank? If Charlie's later route can't be verified, his "Alice was alive" claim is worthless.

I'm voting Charlie. He admitted to being alone with Alice in weapons.

This is a tough one. Both Bob and Charlie have plausible accusations against each other, and I want to think through the timing carefully.

Charlie admitted to being in weapons at tick 9 with Alice alive. Bob's accusation is that Charlie killed her then. But here's the thing — if Charlie killed Alice at tick 9, the body would have been sitting in weapons for 5-6 ticks before Bob "found" it. That's a long time for a killer to leave the scene and let someone else stumble on it, which actually fits Charlie's story of leaving Alice alive better than a fresh kill scenario.

Bob's route ends at weapons where he reports the body immediately on arrival. That's the classic self-report pattern. And Diana confirmed Bob left electrical to cafeteria at tick 12, putting him in weapons around tick 14 — right when the meeting was called.

Bob's defense that "weapons is on my task list so I had a reason to go there" is reasonable, but it doesn't clear him — killers can also have tasks in rooms.

The key question for me: did anyone see Charlie in security or navigation after weapons? If Frank was in navigation around ticks 4-6 he'd have already left by the time Charlie got there, so that's not verifiable either way.

I'm leaning Bob. The self-report at the end of a route into the victim's room is a stronger pattern than Charlie's upfront admission. But I want to give Frank a chance to confirm or deny seeing Charlie in security/navigation before locking in. Right now: Bob.

To answer Bob's direct question: no, I did not see Charlie in security or navigation. I was in security around ticks 1-3 and navigation around ticks 4-6. Charlie says he got to security after weapons (so after tick 9) and then navigation — I was already gone to storage by then, so our paths wouldn't have crossed. I can't confirm or deny his later route.

Now my analysis. The heat is rightfully off me now — Charlie and Diana's timeline reconstruction shows I went the wrong direction from security to be the weapons killer, and Charlie confirmed Alice was alive at tick 9 when I was already in storage/medbay area.

Between Bob and Charlie, I'm leaning Bob for these reasons:

1. **Self-report pattern**: Bob's route ends exactly at the victim's room. He arrives and immediately reports. That's textbook.

2. **Timing fits Bob perfectly**: Diana confirmed Bob left electrical at tick 12 to cafeteria. Cafeteria -> weapons is 2 ticks = tick 14 arrival. Meeting called immediately. Fresh kill, fresh report.

3. **Charlie's openness**: Charlie volunteered that he was in weapons. A killer wouldn't volunteer that unless forced — and nobody had placed him there yet. That's a tell of honesty, not cleverness. If he killed Alice at tick 9, why would he name the room at all?

4. **Bob's accusation of me was misdirection**: Bob led with "suspicious of Frank" when my route literally goes the opposite direction from weapons. That felt like a deflection from the start.

Charlie's accusation against me is also worth noting — he correctly observed I went AWAY from weapons, which a Duck Charlie probably wouldn't bother defending me on.

I'm voting Bob.

I've heard everyone now, and I want to lock in my vote.

The key facts: Charlie admitted being in weapons at tick 9 with Alice alive. Bob's route ends at weapons at tick 14 where he immediately reports. I personally confirmed Bob left electrical at tick 12 toward cafeteria — that puts him in weapons around tick 14, exactly when the meeting was called. That's a fresh kill, fresh report pattern.

Bob's defense that weapons is on his task list is plausible but doesn't clear him — Ducks can fake-task too.

What tips me toward Bob over Charlie:
1. Charlie volunteered he was in weapons before anyone placed him there. A Duck would hide that, not advertise it.
2. Bob led his speech by tunneling on Frank, whose route goes the OPPOSITE direction from weapons. That felt like deflection.
3. The timing of Bob's arrival at weapons matches the meeting call too perfectly.
4. If Charlie killed at tick 9, the body sat for 5+ ticks — unusual for a Duck who'd want distance, but Charlie did leave the area.

Frank, Eve, Charlie and I have reasonable cross-alibis in medbay/electrical. Bob's later movements after electrical are unverified except by me seeing him leave toward cafeteria.

I'm voting Bob.

Everyone's already heard my route and my reasoning, so I'll keep this tight.

The case against Bob is solid:
1. Diana directly witnessed Bob leaving electrical to cafeteria at tick 12. Cafeteria -> weapons is 2 ticks. That puts Bob in weapons at tick 14 — and the meeting was called right then. Fresh arrival, fresh report.
2. Alice was alive when I left weapons at tick 9. Someone arrived after me and killed her, and Bob's timeline is the only one that fits a kill that recent.
3. Bob opened by tunneling Frank, whose route goes the opposite direction from weapons. Classic misdirection.
4. Bob's "weapons is on my task list" excuse cuts both ways — it gives him a reason to be there whether he's innocent OR the killer setting up an alibi.

Bob's counter against me is that I "volunteered" being in weapons — but I did that because Diana saw me leave medbay toward cafeteria and the timing would have placed me there anyway. Hiding it would have looked far worse once someone reconstructed the path. Honesty isn't a tell of guilt here; it's just self-preservation.

Frank, Eve, Diana and I all have overlapping alibis in the medbay/electrical corridor. Bob's the only one with means, opportunity, and a self-report at the end of his route.

Voting Bob.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Going to finish my O2 filter task, someone want to come watch my back?

Okay, so I found Diana's body in security. Here's my route this round: I started in electrical doing tasks, went to security and saw Diana's body there, then I went back through electrical, medbay, did tasks in storage and lower_engine, then came back up to cafeteria where I called the meeting.

Important encounters: I saw Charlie in electrical early on (ticks 3-4), then he disappeared from my view until tick 37 when he entered cafeteria from weapons. Frank I saw in lower_engine at ticks 31-32 — he entered from upper_engine at tick 30 — then he showed up in cafeteria at tick 38.

We're down to three: me, Charlie, and Frank. One of them killed Diana in security. Frank was in lower_engine area which is far from security, but Charlie came from weapons which connects more directly toward security via that side of the map. I'm leaning Charlie, but I want to hear both their routes before I commit. Charlie, Frank — explain where you've been.

This is bad. I killed Diana in security and Eve is pointing at me. I need to deflect to Frank hard. Frank entered cafeteria from medbay at tick 37 — and medbay connects to storage which connects to security via that lower route. Let me build a counter-narrative.

"Okay, hear me out carefully. My route: I started in storage, went to medbay, up to cafeteria, did a quick oxygen task, back to cafeteria, then down through electrical to security, then over to weapons, back through security to weapons again, and finally up to cafeteria where Eve called the meeting.

Yes — I was in security. I'll be honest about that. I saw Diana there at tick 33, alive. I moved on to weapons after. So if Diana died after tick 33, sure, I had opportunity — but so did anyone else who passed through.

Here's what bothers me about Eve's story though. Eve, you said you went 'electrical, medbay, storage, lower_engine, back to cafeteria.' That's a huge loop and storage->lower_engine->back up gives you tons of unwitnessed time. And Frank — Frank entered cafeteria from MEDBAY at tick 37, not from upper_engine like Eve implied his route should look. Medbay connects to storage, and storage connects to security's side via navigation. Frank could absolutely have looped through there.

Eve, you said you saw Diana's body in security — what tick was that? Because if it was before tick 33, that contradicts me seeing Diana alive there. And if it was after, then you were also in security around the kill window.

I'm not ready to commit. I want Frank's route first, and I want Eve's exact timing on finding the body."

Alright, listen carefully because Charlie just told several lies about me.

My actual route: navigation → storage → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria. I entered cafeteria from MEDBAY at tick 37, yes — but medbay is also directly connected to cafeteria. I did NOT come from weapons or security.

Critical point: I was in lower_engine at ticks 30-31 and I SAW Eve there. Eve left lower_engine to storage at tick 32. That confirms Eve's story about being in lower_engine. Eve and I were buddied up in that southwest area during the kill window.

Now Charlie — Charlie just admitted he was in SECURITY where Diana's body was found. He claims he saw her alive at tick 33 and moved to weapons. But Eve said Charlie entered cafeteria from weapons at tick 37. That's a very tight window where Charlie was bouncing around security/weapons — exactly where the body is.

Also, Charlie tried to frame me by saying "medbay connects to storage which connects to security via navigation." Look at the map — navigation connects to storage and to security, sure, but my path was navigation→storage at the START of the round, not near the kill. And I have Eve as my witness in lower_engine.

Charlie has no witness. Charlie admits being in security. Charlie is trying to muddy timing to deflect.

I'm voting Charlie.

Alright, I've heard both of you now. Let me address Charlie's questions and lay out what I know for sure.

To answer Charlie: I found Diana's body in security around tick 9-10, very early. I went electrical (ticks 1-4), then security where I saw the body, then immediately backtracked. So Charlie — if you saw Diana "alive" in security at tick 33, that's a flat-out lie. She was already dead there from the very beginning of the round. I didn't report immediately because Bob had just been ejected last meeting and I wanted to finish tasks and gather more info before calling another meeting.

That's a huge problem for Charlie. He just fabricated seeing Diana alive at tick 33 in a room where she was already a body. That's not a memory error — that's a duck trying to insert himself into a fake timeline.

Frank's story checks out with mine: I saw him in lower_engine at ticks 31-32, and he saw me there too. We're each other's alibi for the southwest loop. And Charlie confirmed he was in security AND came from weapons at tick 37 — exactly the kill area side of the map.

Also Charlie tried to misdirect by saying Frank came from medbay — but medbay connects directly to cafeteria, that's a totally normal path and matches Frank's stated route.

I'm voting Charlie. He lied about seeing Diana alive, he admits being in security, and he has no witness.

I already gave my route. Eve, your timing claim is convenient but inconsistent. You say you found Diana's body at tick 9-10 in security, then "backtracked immediately" — but then you describe this huge loop through electrical, medbay, storage, lower_engine before calling a meeting nearly 30 ticks later. You sat on a body for almost the entire round? That's not cautious, that's suspicious. A real Goose finding a body that early reports it, especially after Bob was just ejected — we needed that info.

And conveniently, your "I saw the body at tick 9" claim now invalidates my testimony about Diana. How tidy. You couldn't have predicted I'd mention Diana, so you adjusted your timeline to make me a liar.

On Diana at tick 33 — I'll be honest, I may have misremembered the tick. I passed through security multiple times. I saw someone in security and assumed it was Diana alive. If she was already a body, then I saw a body and didn't recognize it as such from a distance — that's possible in a quick pass-through.

Frank, your alibi with Eve only works if Eve is telling the truth. You two vouching for each other in lower_engine is exactly what two ducks would do. One of you killed Diana early — probably Eve, since she admits being in security at tick 9 — and the other is covering.

I'm not the killer. I'm voting Eve. She sat on a body for 28 ticks and her story is too neat.

Charlie, nice try, but you just walked yourself into a corner.

First — Eve sitting on the body is unusual, sure, but it's not proof of anything. After Bob got wrongly ejected last meeting, being cautious about calling another meeting without more info is actually reasonable. And critically: her story about lower_engine at ticks 31-32 matches what I personally witnessed. I SAW Eve in lower_engine. She can't have killed Diana in security at tick 9 and also been where I saw her — unless you're claiming she teleported, which she didn't, she walked a normal route.

Second — your "I misremembered the tick" backpedal is damning. You didn't say "I might have seen Diana." You said specifically "I saw Diana there at tick 33, alive." That was a confident, specific claim designed to create a fake alibi window. Now that Eve's revealed the body was there from tick 9, you're suddenly fuzzy on details. That's a duck adjusting his story in real time.

Third — you admit being in security AND weapons during the round. That's exactly the kill zone. Meanwhile Eve and I have mutual confirmation in the southwest, far from security.

Your "Eve and Frank are both ducks covering" theory requires two ducks in a 1-duck game. There's only one duck left, Charlie, and it's you.

Voting Charlie.
